note: Pre-#561 factory bank: every PRESETS id with its normalised Patch and its presetCatalog.ts metadata, captured from main at 003998af before the patches/*.json migration. Numbers are the live doubles, unrounded.

lead-bell.description: Original FM bell. Try C4–C5 with sparse delay.

pad-drift.description: Original slow drifting pad. Hold chords for several seconds.

ai-voice.description: Original formant voice with fixed-frequency modulators.

bass-digital.description: Original digital bass. Start in C2–C3.

snare.description: Original FM body plus noise snare.

weapon-zap.description: Retained for existing documents. Legacy gameplay sound.

horde-horn.description: Retained for existing documents. Legacy gameplay sound.

pickup-blip.description: Retained for existing documents. Legacy gameplay sound.

build-thunk.description: Retained for existing documents. Legacy gameplay sound.

score-drowned-cellos.description: Play C2–C4; hold 3–6 seconds. Keep room send subtle.

score-estuary-violas.description: Play C3–C5 in open fifths; a little plate blends the attacks.

score-salt-violins.description: Play C4–C6; use soft velocity for distant upper lines.

score-muted-chamber.description: Play C3–C5; close triads and short releases suit sparse scoring.

score-frozen-bow.description: Play C3–C5; hold slowly for the glassy beating to emerge.

score-rust-ensemble.description: Play C2–C4; single notes or fifths keep the inharmonic edge clear.

score-low-tremolo.description: Play C2–C3; quick drift in FM brightness gives restless bow texture.

score-high-tremolo.description: Play C4–C5; repeat short notes under a quieter sustained voice.

score-hollow-bows.description: Play C3–C4; bandpassed body leaves room for a separate bass.

score-violet-section.description: Play C3–C5; leave space between chord changes for the release.

score-wire-harmonics.description: Play C4–C6; isolated notes or octave doubles with plate.

score-silt-contrabass.description: Play C2–C3; slow roots under upper-register atmosphere.

score-breathing-rosin.description: Hold C3–C4 for 5 seconds or longer; sparse voicings.

score-afterimage-quartet.description: Play C3–C5; restrained three-note chords and modest room send.

score-black-ice-strings.description: Hold C3–C5 for 6–8 seconds; the slow FM bloom is the gesture.

score-remote-orchestra.description: Play C3–C5; long open chords with a generous plate send.

score-harbour-fog.description: Hold C3–C5 for 6 seconds; low-velocity open chords.

score-deep-current.description: Play C2–C4; use one or two notes below the melody.

score-empty-station.description: Play C3–C5; plate lengthens the empty-room impression.

score-blue-vapour.description: Play C4–C5; soft dyads over a dark bass.

score-tape-halo.description: Play C3–C5; add a damped dotted-eighth delay on the mixer.

score-night-choir.description: Hold C3–C4 for 6 seconds; fifths leave the vocal colour uncluttered.

score-glass-horizon.description: Play C4–C6; use a restrained plate send for upper light.

score-underwater-room.description: Play C3–C4; slightly stagger chord notes into damped delay.

score-ash-cathedral.description: Play C3–C5; hold sparse intervals for 8 seconds.

score-soft-machinery.description: Play C3–C5; shorter chords expose the changing FM edge.

score-polar-bloom.description: Hold C3–C5 for 8 seconds to hear the delayed brightness.

score-amber-ceiling.description: Play C3–C5; a gentle, relatively open harmonic bed.

score-ghost-formants.description: Play C3–C5; single-note melodies or widely spaced chords.

score-low-weather.description: Play C2–C3; sustained fundamentals with an unsettled edge.

score-faded-neon.description: Play C4–C5; clipped chords into the mixer delay.

score-quiet-reactor.description: Play C3–C4; hold against a sparse ticking layer.

score-long-dusk.description: Hold C3–C5 for 8–10 seconds; allow the full release.

score-silver-dust.description: Play C4–C6; quiet notes above a darker sustained pad.

score-buried-voices.description: Play C2–C4; use sparse intervals and low mixer level.

score-magnetic-veil.description: Play C3–C5; evolving detuned body without a long swell.

score-tidal-memory.description: Play C3–C4; let one chord fade before introducing the next.

score-pale-monolith.description: Hold one C3–C4 note for 10 seconds; inharmonic upper haze.

score-velvet-airlock.description: Play C3–C5; short gentle chord answers between bass notes.

score-open-sea.description: Play C3–C5; sustained open fifths with room send to taste.

score-concrete-chord.description: Play short C3–C5 minor chords; add damped dotted-eighth delay.

score-moss-stab.description: Play C3–C4 offbeat chords; keep the bass on another part.

score-porcelain-drop.description: Play C4–C6 single notes; plate and sparse delay repeats.

score-wooden-pin.description: Play C3–C5 in a sparse sixteenth pattern.

score-rubber-key.description: Play C2–C4; short notes with a warm low-mid bounce.

score-tin-kalimba.description: Play C4–C5; leave rests for the inharmonic tail.

score-felt-circuit.description: Play C3–C5 softly; a restrained melodic starting point.

score-amber-stab.description: Play C3–C5 triads; shorter gates make room for delay.

score-ice-needle.description: Play C5–C6 single notes at low mix level.

score-rusted-tine.description: Play C3–C5; isolated notes make useful uneasy punctuation.

score-submerged-keys.description: Play C3–C4; long damped delay brings the quiet attack forward.

score-wire-harp.description: Play C3–C5 broken chords; leave room for overlapping tails.

score-shortwave-chord.description: Play C3–C5 syncopated stabs with short mixer delay.

score-stone-marimba.description: Play C2–C4 as sparse melodic percussion.

score-hollow-droplet.description: Play C4–C5; single notes over a sustained drone.

score-velvet-offbeat.description: Play C3–C4 chords; slower attack softens the offbeat.

score-glass-pebble.description: Play C4–C6; sparse little accents, not a continuous hat line.

score-bronze-rain.description: Play C3–C5; use few notes to preserve tail headroom.

score-dry-relay.description: Play C3–C5 tight rhythmic chords; delay supplies the sustain.

score-last-light-bell.description: Play C4–C5; long melodic tails into a subtle plate.

score-round-foundation.description: Play C1–C3; keep delay and plate sends near zero.

score-dockside-bass.description: Play C1–C3 syncopated notes; moderate velocity.

score-hollow-anchor.description: Play C1–C3; leave space between notes for the rounded tail.

score-carbon-reed.description: Play C2–C3 short ostinatos below sustained pads.

score-soft-undertow.description: Play C1–C2; longer held roots and very little return send.

score-iron-root.description: Play C1–C3; dry bass stabs with a little filter movement.

score-sine-weight.description: Play C1–C3; a near-sine anchor for busier upper voices.

score-muted-cable.description: Play C2–C3; warm restrained bass notes under dub chords.

score-night-rubber.description: Play C1–C3; tight rhythmic notes with a soft FM knock.

score-low-transformer.description: Play C2–C3; hold a note to hear the FM brightness move.

score-silt-pulse-bass.description: Play C1–C3 repeated short notes; sequence the pulse externally.

score-warm-pressure.description: Play C1–C3; sustained roots with gentle attacks.

score-graphite-bass.description: Play C2–C3; inharmonic transient over a firm fundamental.

score-tunnel-growl.description: Play C1–C3; restrained mixer level beside a quiet drone.

score-felt-sub.description: Play C1–C2; gentle short bass notes in minimal arrangements.

score-copper-step.description: Play C2–C3 sparse syncopated steps; dry or minimal room.

score-vent-breath.description: Hold 3–5 seconds; the filter shapes the noise, keyboard pitch is secondary.

score-silk-swish.description: Tap and release after half a second for a short transition.

score-slow-air-riser.description: Hold 6–8 seconds: the filter opens four octaves; release at the transition.

score-narrow-riser.description: Hold at least 3 seconds; a narrower, brighter build.

score-long-downwash.description: Hold 5 seconds so the descending filter completes before release.

score-quick-downwash.description: Hold about 1.5 seconds; short filtered-noise transition.

score-radio-dust.description: Hold for a static bed; bandpass removes most low-frequency weight.

score-deep-static.description: Hold 2–4 seconds beneath a sparse tonal layer.

score-dry-ticker.description: Hold C3–C5; amplitude pulses at 6 Hz, not tempo-synced.

score-hollow-ticker.description: Hold C3–C4; 3 Hz pulse, or retrigger notes with the sequencer.

score-slow-beacon.description: Hold C3–C4; one amplitude cycle every two seconds.

score-engine-pulser.description: Hold C2–C4; 2 Hz gating for a steady mechanical bed.

score-broken-relay.description: Play short C3–C5 notes; sample-and-hold pitch and filter jumps.

score-data-fragments.description: Play C4–C5 bursts with rests; highpass makes a thin brittle layer.

score-corrupt-clock.description: Hold C3–C4; irregular timbre at a 4 Hz update rate.

score-buffer-drift.description: Hold C3–C4 for several seconds; slow random pitch steps.

score-suspended-steel.description: Hold C2–C4 single notes; inharmonic FM builds a suspended metallic bed.

score-distant-gantry.description: Hold C2–C3 for 6 seconds; add plate to suggest distance.

score-wire-stress.description: Hold C3–C5; keep mixer level low beneath the scene.

score-black-resonator.description: Hold C2–C3 for 8 seconds; slow inharmonic tension.

score-passing-vapour.description: Hold 1–2 seconds then release; manually place ahead of a cut.

score-bright-air-riser.description: Hold at least 1.5 seconds; short high-frequency transition.

score-granular-hiss.description: Hold briefly at low mix level; fast drift roughens the filtered hiss.

score-uneasy-scale.description: Play widely spaced C3–C5 notes; suggests scale of a space, not a tonal scale.
